stem: A parcel of air is warmed during the day while its water vapour content stays unchanged. What happens to its relative humidity?
options: It increases because absolute humidity rises
It stays the same because no water is added
It decreases because its capacity to hold moisture rises
It becomes zero because warm air holds no vapour
